'''Ryan Austin Harvest Storm V 2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Ryan Austin]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13842">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13842 Harvest Storm V 2 0], DeckTech (Ryan "CmdCorranH" Austin, 20 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13842/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13842/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018045008/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13842/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Austin]]
* '''Published:''' 20 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Harvest Storm V 2 0''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 WYS Austin LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The second version of the best deck I've made. Introduces a MASSIVE new Harvest/On The Edge machine that makes this deck a huge retrieval engine.
